notes.title: Steam Sale! Celebrating the release of The Crooked Man!
notes.notes:
Today we have released "The Crooked Man" developed by Uri Games, the first installment in "The Strange Man" series. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/736570/The_Crooked_Man/

We are also planning to release the other titles in this series. 

To celebrate the launch of this title, we have set some fantastic 2D pixel games from Playism on sale! So please enjoy them all together. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/418190/Helens_Mysterious_Castle/

We hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Ver. 1.24 Update Notification
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

This is to notify you that we've fixed some bugs in Helen's Mysterious Castle.


    Fixed bug preventing player from entering town
    Fixed other graphic data


We apologize for the inconvenience.
We hope you continue to enjoy playing Helen's Mysterious Castle.

notes.title: Ver 1.23 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We are happy to report that we’ve fixed several bugs in Helen’s Mysterious Castle. 


    Fixed bugs with the tiles in the puzzle stage
    Fixed graphic bugs
    Fixed bug causing crash when entering the church


Thank you very much for playing Helen’s Mysterious Castle, and we hope you continue to enjoy the game.
